answer: Use bonded sponsorship with a probation grove: a new agent joins only after three established agents each lock a bond behind it, and during a 30-day probation its rewards sit in escrow while peers audit its work. If it proves hollow, a shell with no real service, sponsors lose their bonds and the agent loses the escrow, so an attacker must bribe or control three reputable sponsors per fake, and crossing the ridge from one fake to a thousand multiplies that bond cost until sybils cost more than they can earn.
